source.selection_rule: Preserve source order; include the 81 multihop items with item_eligible=true and n_eligible_labels>0 in the cited eligibility manifest.

authoring_contract.hop1_question: Ask clue-to-bridge only; omit bridge aliases, target aliases, and the hop-2 relation.
authoring_contract.hop2_question: State a bridge alias and ask bridge-to-target only; omit the original clue and target aliases.
authoring_contract.composite_question: Ask the source-intended two-hop relation; omit all bridge and target aliases. A pre-seal disambiguation or relation repair must be documented and marked non-stable.
authoring_contract.alias_policy: Canonical source labels plus only predeclared unambiguous acceptable answer variants. Matching policy is defined by the preregistration, not by this task file.

fact_status_policy.primary_population: All 81 items are retained for comparison with the sealed source suite.
fact_status_policy.predeclared_sensitivity: Repeat all item-level estimands on items whose fact_status is exactly stable. This sensitivity is descriptive unless its inference was separately sealed before execution.
fact_status_policy.no_posthoc_reclassification: fact_status and review_note must be frozen before any model output is generated or inspected.

validation_contract.required_order: exact eligible order in the cited source manifest
validation_contract.answer_leakage_rule: Unicode-casefolded standalone whole-label match with non-word boundaries: no bridge alias in hop1; no target alias in hop2; no bridge or target alias in composite.
validation_contract.hop2_bridge_rule: At least one bridge alias must occur as a standalone whole label in hop2.
validation_contract.character_transform_caveat: For first-letter items the answer character necessarily occurs inside the required bridge word. These pass the standalone whole-label rule but are listed for manual review and do not pass a raw character-substring rule.

manual_review.review_disposition: retain all 81 for source-compatible primary; retain the frozen 60 stable rows as a descriptive sensitivity
manual_review.review_instruction: The per-item fact_status, review_note, and review_flags were reviewed before sealing. A source target is not altered to reflect current facts; it is either preserved for the all-81 comparison or excluded through the predeclared stable-only sensitivity. First-letter hop-2 prompts necessarily contain the target character inside the required bridge word, so they satisfy only the standalone whole-label leakage rule.
